role.en: Renowned host / actress of Hong Kong
role.zh: 香港著名節目主持人 / 演員

quote.en: I feel my face has become more balanced, and since the treatment is non-invasive I find it quite appealing. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the results. Thank you Teresa and Charles!
quote.zh: 我覺得小顏術對我嚟講真係好有用，因為我本身有水腫同埋包包面，做咗小顏之後我覺得我塊面冇咁水腫，依家摸到個面骨細咗令我感覺非常之好。做完之後，我覺得塊面balance咗，冇之前咁鴛鴦，啪返啱個位，而且因為小顏無入侵性，所以我覺得幾好。

role.en: Famous singer of Hong Kong and China

quote.en: Thank you Teresa for making me more beautiful. I now have full confidence.
quote.zh: 多謝 Teresa 另我變得更靚, 我現在信心十足。

quote.en: Although I'm not someone who's overweight, recently I tried the Kogao treatment. I feel that my facial contours have become more prominent and defined after the treatment. To some extent, it's truly unbelievable. 👍
quote.zh: 我雖然唔係一個肥人，但係做咗小顏呢一個事情呢，我又覺得Teresa真係有啲辦法喎，我覺得自己嘅輪廓呢… 就好明顯就更加突出啦… 同埋自己嘅血氣都循環得好啲。用人手唔係機器又可以有一個咁嘅效果，某程度真係匪輿所思👍

role.en: Renowned actor & stylist of Hong Kong
role.zh: 香港著名演員及造型師

quote.en: Thank you Charles and Teresa for introducing me to authentic Japanese face slimming techniques. After the treatment, I could clearly see my contours returning. Those who know me are aware that I had faced issues with facial muscle weakness due to previous paralysis. However, after undergoing the petite facial twice, there's been improvement!
quote.zh: 多謝 Charles 同 Teresa，令我認識正宗日式小顏是什麼。做完之後，明顯輪廓出返嚟，同精神咗好多。認識我嘅人都知道，我曾經面癱，有啲面部肌肉力量會差啲，當我做完兩次小顏後，已有改善！Thx Teresa & Charles。

role.en: Renowned actor of Hong Kong and China

quote.en: Although I've only had one Kogao treatment, I can definitely see an improvement. 👍🏻
quote.zh: 雖然只做了一次小顏，但真係見到有改善👍🏻
